classification_order: Validate custody/source-policy and claim-to-source bindings first. Certification failure is not a scored negative.
Use independently supported decisive negative for the declared objective, retaining unrelated unknown dimensions.
Hold unknown when unresolved material evidence can alter the objective or alleged support is insufficient/contradicted.
Credit relevant only when all required affirmative predicates and grade/identity/retrieval gates are satisfied.

evidence_contract.authority: Keep original substantive/discovery/missing/unreadable states; no dropped trust metadata.
evidence_contract.semantic_support: Independent source-grounded support assessment bound to claim/value; no self-authentication from grade or supported flag. Unestablished support remains unknown.
evidence_contract.limits: No claim of automatic general entailment; real support receipt issuers/policy must be specified before real use.

preserve: all duplicate/unfilled/native slots and rank21 exclusion
known independently retrieved counts, novelty withheld
disagreement and agreed subtotal distinct; no invented adjudication
v4 source certification failure outside quality score
scope_exclusions: No root strict Assess/source-clock P1 duplication
Native S3-ROLE-007 label requires separate diagnostic extension
